Function: Maximum length of distances between seeds
Comment: The default value of 100 guarantees that queries >=200 bp will match at least two seeds. ► Large regions with no seeds are called sketching deserts. Deserts with seed distance larger than this value will be filled by choosing k-mers roughly every --seed-in-desert-dist (50 by default) bases. ■ Bigger values decrease the search sensitivity for distant targets, speed up indexing, decrease indexing memory usage, and decrease index size. Alignment speed is largely unaffected.

Bigger values accelerate the search speed at the cost of a higher disk read load. ► The value should not exceed the maximum number of open files set by the operating system. ► Make sure the value of `-j/--threads` in `lexicmap search` is >= this value.

Function: Number of threads for merging seed chunks from all batches
Comment: Merging reserves 8 open files. The actual number of merging threads is min(--seed-data-threads, (--max-open-files - 8)/($inputs + $outputs)), where $inputs is the current group size and $outputs is 2, or 3 for the final merge with `--seed-index2`. ■ Bigger values increase I/O load in HDDs for large batch counts.

Function: Number of partitions for indexing each seed file
Comment: Bigger values slightly increase memory usage. ► After indexing, `lexicmap utils reindex-seeds` can be used to reindex the seed data with another value of this flag.

Recommended. Speeds up prefix matching in large indexes by using longer prefixes to locate seeds within large data blocks. Overall gains are most noticeable for batch queries with `lexicmap search` when `-n/--top-n-genomes` limits downstream alignments, making seed matching a larger share of runtime. Without this limit, sequence alignment often dominates runtime. Writes both indexes alongside the final seeds. Produces the same indexes as `lexicmap utils reindex-seeds2`. Uses `--partitions` (power of 4, at least 4); K minus the primary prefix length must be in [2, 20].

Function: Minimum seed block size for a secondary index
Comment: Used with `--seed-index2`; equivalent to `reindex-seeds2 --threshold`. The additional `.idx15` files are typically similar in size to the `.idx` files, and often smaller. Higher values reduce `.idx15` size but limit the speedup. The default `8K` is recommended.

Used in merging indexes of multiple genome batches (minimum: 12, or 13 with `--seed-index2`), including 8 reserved files. Large batch counts are merged in multiple rounds. Increasing the budget can allow more merging threads; set `ulimit -n` at least this high.
